stories.title: ECP issues notice to Attaullah Tarar for alleged code of conduct violation ahead of NA-77 by-election
stories.brief: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) on Saturday issued a notice to Information Minister Attaullah Tarar for allegedly violating the code of conduct during the by-election in NA-77 Gujranwala.

stories.title: LPG availability, fair pricing among govt priorities, says petroleum minister
stories.brief: Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik said on Saturday that addressing public concerns over the availability and unfair pricing of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) was a government priority. According to state-run Radio Pakistan, the minister attended the first meeting of the committee formed to ensure transparent auction of LPG.

stories.title: Fair LPG pricing, availability government priority, says Ali Pervaiz Malik
stories.brief: Speaking during the meeting, Malik said the initiative aims to ensure fair market opportunities, improve LPG availability and protect consumers. (2/2) Under the mechanism, 10% of indigenous LPG will be allocated to state-owned companies for hard areas, while 90% will be auctioned transparently.

stories.title: Expanding on naval blockade, US military looks to restrict Iranian land commerce

stories.brief: Three people familiar with the White House and Vance's communications told Reuters that the vice president was not breaking with Trump and said White House chief of staff Susie Wiles knew in advance about Vance's post.

stories.title: PML-N's ex-AJK PM Raja Haider appeals to authorities to 'intervene before it's too late' in Rawalakot
stories.brief: The city is currently gripped by unrest amid alleged clashes between security forces and supporters of the proscribed Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC) rights group, with casualties reported. Tensions escalated after the AJK government proscribed the JAAC on June 6, ahead of a planned long march and protest on June 9.

stories.title: Standing in the way of slop bowls: the woman blocking food delivery robots
stories.brief: Tucked away in a dingy alley, opposite a garage called Patriot Parking, 78-year-old Carolyn Marvin is laying out some ground rules for a robot-disrupting expedition. Once a suitable target is identified, we will follow it to a busy sidewalk and Marvin will stand in front of the robot, blocking its way.
